title: scene-server: test vendor extension properties are patchable
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.4 (spec 9e1bedb, reworded by 4ffb96e; scene draft 77c3474 L736 MAY + RFC 8620 §5.3). Code already accepts vendor extension property patches (scene-server src/asset.rs:436-464 reject_read_only_patch; object.rs:614-643, avatar.rs:469-527, region.rs:567; types keep them via extra catch-all) but no scene test covers the acceptance half. Add tests for at least SceneAsset and SceneObject: update with {"vendor.example:tag": 1} plus a spec-patchable property -> updated; /get shows the vendor property persisted. Second case: vendor key together with blobId -> invalidProperties naming only blobId. Oracle: the L736 MAY text. Test-only; no code change expected (if a test fails, that is a real bug: fix the code).
